texto: **potrzebować** is used to express a need with genitive: **potrzebuję większej torby**. In courtesy questions, **czy mogę…?** means «Can I?».
The adjective is in line with the name **inny kolor**, **wygodne buty**. In Polish the subject can be omitted if it is already clear.
